{
 "path": "programs/task-11897266.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Keep marks present in matching cells on both sides of a solid divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full-width horizontal divider first.
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        width = min(w, len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(n)]
    # Otherwise use a full-height vertical divider.
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] and grid[r][c] != 0
                           for r in range(h))), None)
    if col_sep is not None:
        a, b = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid], [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(col_sep, w - col_sep - 1)
        return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
    return []
"
